attributes.morphology: dark-gray network on Nbss boundaries and small particles on Nbss

evidence.quote: The microstructure of alloy AC1 was composed of the gray-white Nbss matrix, dark-gray Nb3Si network distributed on the boundaries of the Nbss phases and small dark-gray Nb3Si particles presented on the Nbss phases (Fig.2(a)).

However, parts of the dark-gray Nb3Si network distributed on the boundaries of Nbss phases were broken and the volume fraction of Nb3Si phase decreased from 8% in alloy AC1 to 4% in alloy AC2 (Fig.2(b)). Simultaneously, the size of Nbss decreased when Zn was added.

However, parts of the dark-gray Nb3Si network distributed on the boundaries of Nbss phases were broken and the volume fraction of Nb3Si phase decreased from 8% in alloy AC1 to 4% in alloy AC2 (Fig.2(b)).
The difference from the microstructural morphology of alloy AC1 is that the size of the Nbss increased and the solution of Si and Ti in Nbss increased as Mg was added.

It was suggested that the alloy AC4 consisted of the Nbss, Nb3Si and α-Nb5Si3. Compared to the alloy AC1, there was a new α-Nb5Si3 phase present as P was added.
